name: physical-intelligence-lab
description: A live physical-intelligence control room with browser vision, world state and simulated robotics.

scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-studio.mjs && node scripts/prepare-city.mjs && node scripts/prepare-portal.mjs && node scripts/prepare-unified.mjs && next dev
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-studio.mjs && node scripts/prepare-city.mjs && node scripts/prepare-portal.mjs && node scripts/prepare-unified.mjs && node --check public/room/studio.js && node --check public/room/city-studio.js && node --check public/room/city-scene.js && node --check public/room/city-vision.js && next build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
